{{Top}}
[[File:Ordnance_Tubes_XWM_Mariusz_Gandzel.png|thumb|right|250px|''Raider''-class corvette concussion missile launchers firing]]
A '''concussion missile launcher''' was used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to fire [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. These concussion missile launchers were great for both attacking and defending from other small starfighters and freighters, though they were less effective against larger starships.
